digest.component_or_area: LLM sub-call model-class routing across review gates
propositions: Four hand-built RunRequest sites pass config=cfg with no declared model class, so they inherit cfg.model and bypass the three-class configuration, sending content to direct Anthropic instead of the configured Bedrock provider.
overlap-judge is the dominant plan-review consumer (18 of 23 calls) yet bypasses class config, so a class-only Bedrock cutover leaves the majority of plan-review traffic on direct Anthropic.
ticket-digest runs on the ticket store write path via enrich_drain.maybe_drain (not inside any gate), silently sending ticket content to direct Anthropic on ordinary rebar comment/create calls.
A regression test must pin the class-only config (Config B), not the all-on-Bedrock config, since a bypassing call still lands on Bedrock when cfg.model is Bedrock, making Config A pass even unfixed.

The fix binds each site to a chosen class via resolve_model_string inside existing fail-safes, and a general AST provenance guard traces every RunRequest's config= expression backwards to flag any future raw-cfg.model inheritance without enumerating specific sites.

A raised inconsistency: ticket-quality (a single-call top-level op) was assigned frontier but is structurally like spec_scan and should revert to raw cfg.model, since the class vocabulary is meant for per-pass differentiation inside a gate.
